info.title: Speedo Live API
info.description:
Speedo Live: bus tracking and route navigation for Lahore.

Authenticate with `POST /api/auth/login` and send `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.
Live positions stream over the `/ws/live` WebSocket.

In DEMO mode all buses, routes and schedules are simulated sample data.

post.description: Create a passenger account with email or phone and a password.
Log in with email or phone. Works for passengers, drivers and admins.
Tokens are stateless; the client discards its token. Kept so apps have a single logout call.

get.description: Operating mode. In demo mode every bus and route shown is simulated sample data.
List routes. with_path=true adds the line geometry and ordered stops for drawing on a map.
Ranked by passenger journeys and favourites in the last 30 days.
Live ETAs from fresh GPS, plus scheduled times. Scheduled entries are never presented as live.
Latest state of every bus. Subscribe to /ws/live for updates.

post.description: Find Speedo routes between two places (coordinates or stops), with up to one transfer.

get.description: Route operating hours and scheduled times at major stops (today, Pakistan time).

post.description: Register an FCM device token for push notifications.
Ask to be notified when a bus on this route is a few minutes from this stop.
Start (or resume) a trip on the assigned bus. Requires explicit location-sharing consent.
Send one or more GPS fixes (buffered fixes from offline periods are accepted up to 1 hour old).

delete.description: Deactivates by default (keeps trip history). hard=true deletes the bus and its history.

get.description: Live fleet with assigned driver names (admin only).

post.description: Import verified route data. Replaces the stop list (and schedules, if given) of each route in the file.

get.description: Non-secret runtime settings (change them through environment variables).
